name: News Editors
bio: News Editors curate explainers, reading notes and practical technology guides, with primary links included whenever they help readers check the work.

name: Elena Marsh
bio: Elena Marsh writes about geopolitics, natural disasters and the international events reshaping regions across the globe, with a particular interest in the Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.

name: Marcus Cole
bio: Marcus Cole writes about companies, earnings and the deals reshaping the economy, with a focus on the strategies and industries behind the numbers.

name: Danny Rand
bio: Danny Rand covers markets, the Federal Reserve and personal finance, translating interest-rate decisions, market swings and household debt trends into what they actually mean for readers.
